qa: It means you can look at all of the cards in your security stack, without revealing them to your opponent. If a card that can be played by the effect is among them, you may reveal that card and play it.
extracted.special_digivolution_condition: [Digivolve] 2 from Lv.3 w/[Agumon] in name and [Dinosaur] trait

text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [Digivolve] 2 from Lv.3 w/[Agumon] in name and [Dinosaur] trait

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [When Digivolving] Search your security stack, and you may play 1 red or yellow Tamer card among it without paying the cost. If you did, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.) Then, shuffle your security stack.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your red or yellow Tamers becomes suspended, you may delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
